name: Wrenix of Ratchet
summary: In Orgrimmar, Wrenix of Ratchet draws Horde rogues toward a goblin port far to the south. Zando'zan sends them to aid Wrenix the Wretched, a disreputable goblin in Ratchet.

sections.title: A Prophet in the Shadows
sections.body: In Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, the rogue guild works out of winding crevices, largely unseen. Zando'zan, a troll who speaks in wild ramblings, greets operatives with ominous portents. His visions include Warchief Thrall struck down by poison and blade. He gives no explanation for the prophecy, and quickly sends agents south to the port town of Ratchet in the Barrens.

sections.title: Ratchet's Problem Solver
sections.body: Ratchet lies on the Barrens coast, east of the Crossroads. Scoundrels, mercenaries, and tinkerers gather in the neutral port, where Wrenix the Wretched makes his home. Wrenix has little patience for Zando'zan's eccentric ways. He says the troll's earlier recruits met grim ends in the bay, among its hungry predators.

faq.answer: Zando'zan, a troll of the Shattered Hand in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, sends you south after blurting out strange visions.
Wrenix the Wretched is a goblin contact in Ratchet. He handles covert work and mechanical supplies for rogues across the Barrens.

faq.q: What happened to the operatives sent before me?
faq.answer: Wrenix says the five agents Zando'zan sent before you failed their assignments and became shark food off Ratchet's coast.

faq.q: What was Zando'zan talking about regarding Thrall?
faq.answer: Zando'zan says he saw Thrall struck down by a poisoned dagger in the back, then cuts himself off and changes the subject.
Ratchet sits on the eastern coast of the Barrens, directly east of the Crossroads. Roads running south from the Southfury River connect it to Durotar.

faq.q: What comes next after meeting Wrenix?
faq.answer: When you greet Wrenix, he gives you 'Plundering the Plunderers': infiltrating the Southsea Freebooters along the coast south of Ratchet.

angles.text: As a Horde rogue, you leave Orgrimmar's safety and enter neutral pirate territory as an essential step in your training.
As a member of the Horde, you know the Shattered Hand keeps eyes and ears beyond Durotar's borders. It often relies on neutral ports like Ratchet for sensitive contracts.
